title: Basketball Court
content: The college has a dedicated basketball court available for students as part of its sports facilities.

title: Canteens and Food
content: There are four main food facilities on campus where you can eat. The Food Court is beside A-Block. Another canteen is near the basketball court. A CCD outlet is opposite the main gate for light snacks and beverages. A food counter near the sports complex serves lunch at 1 PM and South Indian snacks and beverages at 10:30 AM. There are also muliple outlets outside the campus like Mumbai Chai, Dolphin Cafe, Kings cofee and more!

title: General Campus Facilities
content: VVCE offers modern infrastructure, well-equipped laboratories, sports facilities, hostels, and other student support amenities. For detailed information, students may visit the official college website.

title: Scholarships
content: There are scholarships available for students in vvce based on merit and need-based scholarship.. other than college scholarships there are other government scholarships like SSP, and other various scholarships.

title: Transport and Bus Facilities
content: VVCE provides bus facilities for students and staff. For transport-related queries, contact the transport coordinator or visit the main office for schedules and routes.

title: Drinking Water Facilities
content: Drinking water facilities are available in all major blocks including M Block, A Block, B Block, C Block, and D Block. Water coolers and RO systems are installed on each floor usually at the corners.

title: Stationery Shop
content: Stationery items, books, and supplies can be purchased from the department shop located near food court in the campus. There are also xerox shops nearby the campus for student use.

title: Parking Facilities
content: Parking facilities are available for both two-wheelers and four-wheelers. Designated parking areas are located near the main entrance and around different blocks on campus.

title: Medical Facilities
content: VVCE has medical facilities including a first aid kit and ambulance service on campus. For medical emergencies, contact the main office or security immediately.

title: Smoking Policy
content: Smoking is strictly prohibited on the VVCE campus. The college maintains a smoke-free environment for the health and safety of all students and staff.

title: Campus Size
content: The VVCE campus is spread across 23 acres of land with modern infrastructure, multiple buildings, sports facilities, hostels, and green spaces.

title: Training and Placment Department
keywords: what does training and placment department offer
content: The Training department offers training with multiple tie-ups with prominent trainers from 10 seconds, biozotic and more. Also they have multiple industry partners for training students in various fields.
